description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Eternal Scourge is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard due to Rest in Reace.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Rocco triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control and creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Squirrel, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
